items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: There was a little kid he called Lil Jon, a great little drummer. And something was wrong with his spine, so he was giving this benefit for his medical bills, you know.

ctx.x: Do you think Rene was like a good reader and all that too? I don't think so. His band was just ad libbing when you heard him.

Well, that's all the whole band was doing. Yeah, they weren't using music at all. Yeah, that's all they was doing. And Lee Collins told me a tale about Rene. He says one day, they were advertising the band, and he saw Louie and Louie came on and got on the wagon. He said, dude, those days it was a wagon. And they always carried a thick rope or chain. See those guys, people would take them lock the wagons together with these chains. And they couldn't get away. They just had to take it if it was better than you,…
Why'd they call you Nosey? I don't call him my nose. Where did you put it? Huh? Where did you put your nose?
